# Project-local workflow skills

The full lifecycle fallback is retired. Keep repository tracker configuration
and local overrides in their existing owner. Install the selected project-local
skills, then invoke setup-workflow-skills only if configuration is needed.
Read only the invoked skill and its relevant references; do not load the catalog.
Existing review/status/acceptance rules remain in force during migration.
Missing orchestration helpers are a capability blocker, not permission to skip gates.
